request.questionText: Scooby-Doo is an American media franchise based on an animated television series (c. 1969) featuring four teenagers and their talking Great Dane dog named Scooby-Doo who solve mysteries sometimes involving supposedly supernatural forces. In 2013, Scooby-Doo was ranked as the fifth-greatest TV cartoon of all time. The data frame in scooby.csv contains information on 527 episodes, including these variables: title -- name of episode date -- date episode aired in the U.S. network -- TV network on which episode aired setting -- type of terrain (e.g., Air, Cave, Coast,...) motive -- objective of antagonist/monster (e.g., Abduction, Counterfeit, Extortion,...) rating -- IMDB.com rating of the episode on a scale from 1 - 10 engagement -- number of reviews on IMDB.com time -- duration of the episode in minutes Which motive is the most common in episodes with an above-average rating and a "Coast" setting?
